requirements.claim: The supplied evidence does not support the sealant bite figure asserted in the question. SSGC:2024 clause 6.2 requires the structural sealant bite to be not less than 6 mm and not less than the value from b_s = W_k * a / (2 * sigma_des), and not greater than three times the glue line thickness.
For projects in Region Q the National Annex clause NA.6.2 raises the minimum structural sealant bite to 8 mm.
applicability_conditions: Applies because the project is stated to be in Region Q.

missing_information: The specific sealant bite value asserted in the question is not stated in any supplied evidence item; the premise of the question cannot be confirmed.
